clues: This town is a port on the Pacific Ocean. It sits on the south coast of Peru.
The Humboldt Current flows past this town from Antarctica. It brings cold water to the local beaches.
For about fifty years, from 1830 to 1880, this port was a key place in the guano trade.
This was once the main port on the south coast of Peru. Now its old port lies in ruins.
The train from Arequipa now comes just in summer. It runs on Saturday and back on Sunday.
